visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Swap In Place Instead of Using a Second Array
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A second array receives the non-zero values and its default zeros fill the rest. Do it in place by swapping each non-zero value into the next free position. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Swapping each non-zero value into the next free slot pushes the zeros back as a side effect, so no extra array is allocated and no fill loop is needed.
